items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: He was considered good. He's alright. ... He was really good, Charlie.

ctx.x: He was considered good. He's alright. Yeah, I couldn't call him Kaiser, but... Tell me what you call him good. You did mention him? Yeah. You didn't mention Charlie McCurtis at all.
No, no, I didn't. Well, that Charlie McCurtis was a good clarinet player.
